record.field: Each party agrees to keep strictly confidential all information, documents, and data exchanged under this agreement, and not to disclose them to any third party without the other party's prior written consent, for the entire term of this agreement and for a period of two (2) years following its expiry or termination.

Either party may terminate this agreement early by giving written notice in accordance with the agreed notice period, subject to settlement of any outstanding financial and contractual obligations.

In the event of a material breach by one party that remains uncured thirty (30) days after notification, the other party may terminate this agreement without notice.
Penalties for late delivery or payment
Any payment not made by its due date shall accrue a penalty equal to the applicable statutory interest rate, calculated on the amount due, without prejudice to any other available remedy.

Each party's liability under this agreement is limited to direct damages and shall not exceed the total amount paid under this agreement during the twelve (12) months preceding the event giving rise to liability. Indirect damages, loss of profit, or reputational harm are excluded.

Unless otherwise agreed, each party retains all pre-existing intellectual property rights. New developments created specifically under this agreement shall be assigned according to the terms set out in the relevant schedule.

The parties agree to process any personal data exchanged under this agreement in compliance with Regulation (EU) 2016/679 and applicable local legislation, and to implement appropriate technical and organizational measures to ensure the security of such data.
Exemption in the event of force majeure

Neither party shall be held liable for any failure to perform its obligations resulting from a force majeure event, as defined by applicable law and case law, provided that the other party is notified as soon as reasonably possible.

This agreement is governed by the law applicable at the company's place of establishment. Any dispute relating to its formation, performance, or interpretation shall be submitted to the exclusive jurisdiction of the courts of that place, failing amicable resolution.
